# World Today News

> Global news source directory aggregating daily headlines and analysis from trusted international outlets with editorial independence and strategic insight.

World Today News is operated by World Today Media Group under the leadership of Editor-in-Chief David Harrison. The site curates global news coverage while maintaining strict data protection compliance (GDPR, CCPA/CPRA) and editorial standards.
